about: The PrompTugal organisation's repositories, as code. Org apply creates any that are missing and sets each one's default branch to dev; on an existing repository it changes only the settings its own entry names. It never deletes, transfers, archives, renames or makes private (policy/abp.json). Listed as they were on 25 Nov 2026 ~22:54 UTC (GitHub search, org:PrompTugal: 22 repositories, all public, all with dev as default branch).
